chunks: Muhammad ibn Isma'il from al-Fadl ibn Shazaan from Safwan ibn Yahya from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar from 'Abd al-Malik ibn 'Amr who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) level the pebbles when he intended to prostrate.
ai.seo_question: What did the Imam do with the pebbles before prostrating?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* illustrates the meticulous care Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) took in preparing the ground for prostration, ensuring a clean and level surface for his forehead. In Shia jurisprudence, this act underscores the importance of *khushu'* (devotion) and the physical purity of the prayer space, reflecting the broader principle that the earth is a place of prostration provided it is pure and free from impurities. It serves as a practical model for worshippers to observe environmental details during Salah, enhancing spiritual presence.
